semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily produces valves for gas applications, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Baitu Cryogenic Valve Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of various types of valves, including special gas valves, cryogenic gas valves, and high-pressure hydrogen valves. With a strong focus on R&D and a significant domestic market presence, the company aims to meet diverse customer needs across multiple specifications and models.

regional_presence.China: The company has three major manufacturing bases located in Jiading, Shanghai; Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu; and Xuancheng, Anhui.
